subject: info-algn
title: INFO.ALGN.------ACC.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 110 (T(AF)M-14). INFO-ALGN (information alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: OP-SPD (option spread), TRS (transition) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From TRS: S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation). From S-ST: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From MT-INFO: C-CONT (composite continuance). RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is on a dotted line from MT-INFO. From C-CONT: OBS (observation) and INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: CRIF-D. From CRIF-D: RE-ST (restructuralism).
